prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: All three frozen neighbors retained. More nominal electrons is already opposed by Nb comparison: Zr state pairs more strongly. ROOT finite native envelope is also lower for Zr than Nb; physical W/mobile n is not claimed. Versions differ across neighbors and fine force is 0.02809 eV/A; this is source finite scalar pairing support, not independent method certification.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.00022400006825056733 eV/Å, pressure 0.0 GPa; fine force 0.02809263679016012 eV/Å, pressure 0.020999999999999998 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: coupled Hf-to-Zr or Ir-to-Rh role construction in Be4XRh. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Read existing Be/Rh/X mode/orbital-resolved evidence to distinguish the large Ir→Rh and Nb→Zr pairing changes. Favorable: coupling gain persists on matched NC/scalar conditions; adverse: a relevant spin/SOC or numerical control reverses it; ambiguous: band envelope alone or missing projections cannot identify cause.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
